gloss: to be scattered, to be dispersed

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {散|ち}らばっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be scattered, to be dispersed, to be strewn about
definitions.explanation: For things to be spread out irregularly across an area, or for people/objects to be distributed widely rather than gathered together.

examples.japanese: ⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{散|ち}らばって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Toys are scattered on the floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{散|ち}らばって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Fallen leaves were strewn across the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{散|ち}らばって⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: The residents live scattered across a wide area.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). The transitive pair is ⟦{散|ち}らす→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧ (to scatter something).

ASPECT (ている):
{散|ち}らばって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the resulting state of being scattered — things are in a scattered arrangement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{散|ち}らばる: X is scattered
- X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{散|ち}らばる: scattered across/in X

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{散|ち}らばる: papers are strewn about
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{散|ち}らばる: scattered here and there
- ⟦{広範囲|こうはんい}→広範囲：17171_kouhani⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{散|ち}らばる: dispersed over a wide area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{散|ち}らかる→散らかる：04357_chirakaru⟧: to be messy, in disarray (implies untidiness)
- {散|ち}らばる: to be scattered, dispersed (more neutral, spatial distribution)
